name: What types of garage renovations are popular in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What types of garage renovations are popular in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the Bay Area, popular garage renovations often include converting garages into Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs), home offices, gyms, or expanded living spaces. Many homeowners also opt for upgrades like improved insulation, updated flooring, enhanced lighting, and custom storage solutions to maximize functionality and comfort within their existing garage structure.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular garage renovations in the Bay Area include ADUs, home offices, gyms, and improved storage or living spaces.
